title: Pillersee St. Ulrich
highlights: Emerald-green mountain lake at the heart of the picturesque Pillerseetal
Refreshing water temperatures and pristine mountain spring water quality
Boat hire offering rowing and pedal boats as well as stand-up paddleboards
Scenic circular hiking trail lined with cozy alpine inns and floating lake stage
kurzbeschreibung: Pillersee in St. Ulrich is the emerald-green heart of the Pillerseetal, framed by the rugged Loferer Steinberge.
beschreibung:
Emerald-Green Heart of the Pillerseetal

The Pillersee lies at an altitude of 835 metres directly at the foot of the rugged Loferer Steinberge near St. Ulrich am Pillersee. With its distinctive emerald-green hue and crystal-clear mountain water, it is the namesake centrepiece of the entire holiday region.

Waterfront Recreation and Lakeside Stage

Even on hot midsummer days, the water remains pleasantly refreshing and rarely exceeds 20 degrees Celsius. Along the lakeside promenade, sunny sunbathing lawns, rowing and pedal boat rentals, and cosy lakeside restaurants invite visitors to unwind. A cultural highlight is the series of summer concerts performed on the covered Seebühne stage.
